_rules: Topic ledger: one entry per story/item per edition. Before building, compare candidate topics against the last 4 editions here; a repeated topic must carry a real verified update (new headline leading with it plus a What changed paragraph) and sit below new stories in its section. The same topic may not lead a section more than 2 editions in a row. Append every edition's entries after publishing.
